description: This file implements the AWCProxyContainer class and its nested DBusInterface class, managing container lifecycle via D-Bus communication, including starting, stopping, and state change handling.

classes.name: AWCProxyContainer
classes.description: Manages container lifecycle, including starting, stopping, and monitoring container state via D-Bus.

classes.name: AWCProxyContainer::DBusInterface
classes.description: Handles D-Bus communication for container state changes and signals.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::AWCProxyContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing container with configuration and D-Bus client.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::~AWCProxyContainer
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and unbinding D-Bus interface.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with the container.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::waitForStateChange
methods.description: Waits for the container to change to a specified state within a timeout.

methods.name: AWCProxyContainer::DBusInterface::onStateChange
methods.description: Handles D-Bus signal for state change, updating container state.
